review_scope: Fixed full 128 hash-ranked candidates, extended from first 32; no outcome-value or return selection. Preserve nonpolitical execution scope, benchmark exclusions, chronological boundaries and old development status. Same-event Olympics, Euro 2024, Super Bowl, chess championship, overlapping NFL fantasy and Red Star season/match groups consolidated. Search relationships remain model-selected. This is discovery training expansion, not fresh evaluation admission.
